Base scheduler steps = total steps. The split-sigmas value = Pass 1 steps (min 6); total minus that = Pass 2 steps (min 4).
E.g. total 12, sigmas 8 → Pass 1 = 8, Pass 2 = 4. Total 10, sigmas 6 → Pass 1 = 6, Pass 2 = 4.

Tip: Pass 1 needs 6+ steps — use 8 for better audio quality.

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Amber, the young woman whose face and hair come from <Picture 1> — coral/orange braided hair with black roots, wearing her signature black leather crop top with a brooch, black mini skirt with a buckle belt, fishnet tights, and black lace-up boots.
<Subject 2> is Ruby, the young woman whose face and hair come from <Picture 2> — deep red hair, wearing her off-shoulder black-and-burgundy corset romper with a cross-strap bodice, thigh garter straps, and buckled knee-high boots.
<Subject 3> is the mountain-ridge trail environment in <Picture 3> — a rocky, grassy alpine trail with wildflower meadows, layered green mountains fading into hazy blue peaks, and loose rock outcrops to scramble over. This is a scene/terrain reference only — it does not dictate any pose or action for <Subject 1> or <Subject 2>.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video shows Amber and Ruby hiking together up a rocky mountain-ridge trail, chatting back and forth as they climb, scrambling over a rock outcrop partway up, and reaching the top together.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 5], [Shot 6]): fully_preserved - Amber's face, hair, and outfit match <Picture 1> exactly in every shot.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 4], [Shot 5], [Shot 6]): fully_preserved - Ruby's face, hair, and outfit match <Picture 2> exactly in every shot.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 5], [Shot 6]): weak_reference - the rocky trail, meadow, and mountain layout set the general terrain and atmosphere; exact rock placement is not required to match.

detailed_description:
The target video is a natural, sunlit outdoor adventure-vlog style with warm daylight, slight handheld camera texture, and no artificial color grading. Any shot showing either woman's face stays medium (chest-up to roughly mid-thigh) or closer; only the opening and closing shots, framed from behind with no faces visible, go wide.
[Shot 1] A wide tracking shot follows Amber and Ruby from directly behind and slightly above head height as they hike up the rocky trail from <Subject 3> side by side, both breathing a little heavy but moving at a steady, confident pace, boots finding footing on the loose rock. Neither face is visible yet. The camera holds a consistent following distance, matching their walking pace exactly.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.500, the shot cuts to a medium two-shot from the side, both women visible chest-up as they continue walking, the mountain trail from <Subject 3> passing behind them. Ruby (S1), her deep red hair catching the sunlight, turns her head slightly toward Amber and says, in a bright, clear voice sitting noticeably high in pitch, with crisp energetic articulation and a cheerful upbeat lift at the end of the sentence, <d>[English] Okay, this view is already worth the burn in my legs.</d>
[Shot 3] At 00:04.500, the shot cuts to a medium close-up on Amber (S2), eye-level, side angle, still walking. She glances over with a small grin, and replies in a soft, breathy voice, warm rather than bright, with a playful light rasp and a relaxed, unhurried, teasing pace, <d>[English] Wait till we hit the top — I heard it's even better up there.</d>
[Shot 4] At 00:06.500, the shot cuts to a medium close-up on Ruby (S1), matching the eye-level side-angle framing of the previous shot, as she laughs lightly and shakes her head, picking up her pace slightly, her tone still bright and quick, <d>[English] You say that every time we hike anywhere.</d>
[Shot 5] At 00:08.500, the shot cuts to a medium shot at the base of a small rock outcrop blocking the trail. Both women reach it together; Amber plants one hand on a fixed rock ledge and pulls herself up and over it in one clean motion, Ruby following a beat behind, gripping the same rock ledge with both hands as she climbs over. No dialogue in this shot — only the physical sound of hands and boots on rock.
[Shot 6] At 00:10.500, the shot cuts to a wide shot from behind as both women crest the ridge together and come to a stop side by side, facing away from camera out toward the layered mountain view from <Subject 3>. Neither face is visible. They stand still for a moment, taking in the view, one of them (Ruby) raising a hand to shield her eyes from the sun.

overall_soundscape:
A light mountain breeze continues throughout, with the steady crunch of boots on rock and dirt, audible breathing effort from the climb, and faint distant birdsong.

N/A
